in_text_mentions: arding diffuse idiopathic pulmonary neuroendocrine cell hyperplasia (DIPNECH). DIPNECH is an under-recognized respiratory disease characterized by the proliferation of neuroendocrine cells in the airway walls 46, 47. It is encountered predominantly in middle-aged women. Radiologically, it is characterized by mosaic attenuation with multiple small nodules ( Figure 2), a combination that is highly suggestive of this disease 48. DIPNECH has been classified as a preinvasive lesion in the category of neuroendocrine tumors in the 2015 World Health Organization (WHO) classification of lung tumors 49.

Three additional small bilateral pulmonary nodules were also identified (Fig. 1).
